```{r}
############################################################
# AURORA OS analysis:
# Exploratory pooled median TFx cutpoint analysis
#
# Input:
#   AURORA_all_patients_median_TFx_OS_clean.csv
#
# Expected columns:
#   patient_id
#   Subtype
#   median_TFx
#   Overall_Survival_days
#   Event
#
# Event:
#   1 = death
#   0 = censored
#
# Main outputs:
#   1. surv_cutpoint-derived exploratory TFx cutoff
#   2. maxstat corrected p-value
#   3. bootstrap cutpoint stability
#   4. KM plots for:
#        - exploratory cutpoint
#        - published 7% cutpoint
#        - current 8.17% median cutpoint
############################################################
```


```{r}
############################################################
# 0. Setup
############################################################

rm(list = ls())

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

required_pkgs <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "readr",
  "stringr",
  "ggplot2",
  "survival",
  "survminer",
  "maxstat",
  "purrr",
  "tibble"
)

missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[!required_pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages())]

if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing packages: ",
    paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "),
    "\nInstall them using:\n",
    "install.packages(c(",
    paste(sprintf('\"%s\"', missing_pkgs), collapse = ", "),
    "))"
  )
}

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(maxstat)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)


############################################################
# 1. User settings
############################################################

survival_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/AURORA/Survival"

input_file <- file.path(
  survival_dir,
  "AURORA_all_patients_median_TFx_OS_clean.csv"
)

out_dir <- file.path(
  survival_dir,
  "OS_exploratory_pooled_median_TFx_cutpoint"
)

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Your current analysis uses TFx >= 3%
TFX_MIN_FILTER <- 3

# Minimum proportion in each group during cutpoint search
MINPROP <- 0.20

# Bootstrap iterations
N_BOOT <- 500

# Comparison cutpoints
PUBLISHED_TFX_CUTPOINT <- 7.00
CURRENT_MEDIAN_CUTPOINT <- 8.17

set.seed(123)


############################################################
# 2. Helper functions
############################################################

clean_event <- function(x) {
  
  if (is.numeric(x) || is.integer(x)) {
    return(as.integer(x))
  }
  
  x0 <- tolower(str_trim(as.character(x)))
  
  out <- case_when(
    x0 %in% c("1", "event", "death", "dead", "yes", "true") ~ 1L,
    x0 %in% c("0", "censored", "censor", "alive", "no", "false") ~ 0L,
    TRUE ~ NA_integer_
  )
  
  return(out)
}


clean_subtype <- function(x) {
  
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_trim(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "Her2", "HER2")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "HER-2", "HER2")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "HR\\+\\s*HER2\\-", "HR+ HER2-")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "HR\\+\\s*HER2\\+", "HR+ HER2+")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "HR\\-\\s*HER2\\-", "HR- HER2-")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "HR\\-\\s*HER2\\+", "HR- HER2+")
  x <- str_squish(x)
  
  return(x)
}


format_p <- function(p) {
  
  if (is.na(p)) return("NA")
  
  if (p < 0.001) {
    return(formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2))
  } else {
    return(formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 4))
  }
}


make_os_km_plot <- function(df, cutpoint, cutpoint_label, out_prefix) {
  
  df_plot <- df %>%
    mutate(
      TFx_group = ifelse(
        median_TFx > cutpoint,
        paste0("High TFx > ", round(cutpoint, 2), "%"),
        paste0("Low TFx ≤ ", round(cutpoint, 2), "%")
      ),
      TFx_group = factor(
        TFx_group,
        levels = c(
          paste0("Low TFx ≤ ", round(cutpoint, 2), "%"),
          paste0("High TFx > ", round(cutpoint, 2), "%")
        )
      )
    )
  
  group_summary <- df_plot %>%
    group_by(TFx_group) %>%
    summarise(
      n_patients = n_distinct(patient_id),
      n_deaths = sum(Event == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_censored = sum(Event == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_TFx = median(median_TFx, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_OS_months_observed = median(OS_months, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  write_csv(
    group_summary,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_group_summary.csv"))
  )
  
  fit <- survfit(
    Surv(OS_months, Event) ~ TFx_group,
    data = df_plot
  )
  
  logrank_obj <- survdiff(
    Surv(OS_months, Event) ~ TFx_group,
    data = df_plot
  )
  
  logrank_p <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_obj$chisq, df = 1)
  
  cox_obj <- coxph(
    Surv(OS_months, Event) ~ TFx_group,
    data = df_plot
  )
  
  cox_summary <- summary(cox_obj)
  
  cox_out <- cbind(
    term = rownames(as.data.frame(cox_summary$coefficients)),
    as.data.frame(cox_summary$coefficients),
    as.data.frame(cox_summary$conf.int)
  )
  
  write_csv(
    cox_out,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_cox_HR.csv"))
  )
  
  median_surv <- surv_median(fit)
  
  write_csv(
    median_surv,
    file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_median_OS.csv"))
  )
  
  label_text <- paste0(
    cutpoint_label,
    "\nCutpoint = ", round(cutpoint, 2), "%",
    "\nLog-rank p = ", format_p(logrank_p)
  )
  
  x_max <- max(df_plot$OS_months, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_label <- x_max * 0.60
  
  km <- ggsurvplot(
    fit,
    data = df_plot,
    risk.table = TRUE,
    conf.int = TRUE,
    censor = TRUE,
    pval = FALSE,
    legend.title = "",
    legend = "top",
    xlab = "Overall survival from diagnosis/baseline date, months",
    ylab = "Overall survival probability",
    risk.table.title = "Number at risk",
    risk.table.height = 0.25,
    ggtheme = theme_classic(base_size = 13)
  )
  
  km$plot <- km$plot +
    annotate(
      "label",
      x = x_label,
      y = 0.95,
      label = label_text,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4,
      fill = "white",
      label.size = 0.25
    ) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
    ) +
    ggtitle(paste0("Overall survival by median TFx: ", cutpoint_label))
  
  km$table <- km$table +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11)
    )
  
  pdf_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_KM_plot.pdf"))
  png_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_KM_plot.png"))
  
  pdf(pdf_file, width = 8.5, height = 7.5)
  print(km)
  dev.off()
  
  png(png_file, width = 2400, height = 2100, res = 300)
  print(km)
  dev.off()
  
  return(
    list(
      fit = fit,
      logrank_p = logrank_p,
      cox = cox_obj,
      group_summary = group_summary,
      median_surv = median_surv
    )
  )
}


############################################################
# 3. Load OS file
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Loading OS file\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop("Input file not found:\n", input_file)
}

# 4. Check required columns
############################################################

  "median_TFx",
  "Overall_Survival_days",
  "Event"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(os_raw))

}

}

    median_TFx = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(median_TFx)),
    Overall_Survival_days = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Overall_Survival_days)),
    OS_months = Overall_Survival_days / 30.4375,
    Event = clean_event(Event)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    patient_id = str_trim(patient_id)
  )

cat("\nBefore filtering:\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(os_df), "\n")
cat("Unique patients:", n_distinct(os_df$patient_id), "\n")
cat("Non-missing median_TFx:", sum(!is.na(os_df$median_TFx)), "\n")
cat("Non-missing OS days:", sum(!is.na(os_df$Overall_Survival_days)), "\n")
cat("Non-missing Event:", sum(!is.na(os_df$Event)), "\n")

# Check duplicated patients
dup_patients <- os_df %>%
  count(patient_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(dup_patients) > 0) {
  cat("\nWARNING: duplicated patient IDs found. Keeping first row per patient.\n")
  print(head(dup_patients, 20))
  
  write_csv(

    file.path(out_dir, "00_duplicated_patient_ids.csv")
  )
  
  os_df <- os_df %>%
    arrange(patient_id) %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Main filter
os_df <- os_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(patient_id),
    patient_id != "",

cat("\nAfter filtering:\n")

cat("Deaths:", sum(os_df$Event == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Censored:", sum(os_df$Event == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Median TFx:", median(os_df$median_TFx, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# 7. Exploratory pooled cutpoint using surv_cutpoint
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Running exploratory pooled surv_cutpoint for OS\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cut_obj <- surv_cutpoint(
  data = os_df,
  time = "OS_months",
  event = "Event",
  variables = "median_TFx",
  minprop = MINPROP
)

cut_summary <- as.data.frame(summary(cut_obj))

cat("\nSurv_cutpoint summary:\n")
print(cut_summary)
str(cut_summary)

write_csv(
  cut_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "03_OS_surv_cutpoint_summary.csv")
)

# Robust extraction
if ("cutpoint" %in% colnames(cut_summary)) {
  
  if ("variable" %in% colnames(cut_summary)) {
    exploratory_cutpoint <- cut_summary$cutpoint[cut_summary$variable == "median_TFx"]
  } else {
    exploratory_cutpoint <- cut_summary$cutpoint[1]
  }
  
} else if ("median_TFx" %in% rownames(cut_summary)) {
  
  exploratory_cutpoint <- cut_summary["median_TFx", "cutpoint"]
  
} else {
  
  stop("Could not extract cutpoint from surv_cutpoint summary. Please inspect cut_summary.")
}

# Final safety check
if (length(exploratory_cutpoint) == 0 || is.na(exploratory_cutpoint[1])) {
  stop("Exploratory cutpoint is empty or NA. Check cut_summary output.")
}

exploratory_cutpoint <- as.numeric(exploratory_cutpoint[1])

cat("\nExploratory pooled median TFx cutpoint for OS:",
    exploratory_cutpoint, "%\n")

# 8. Maxstat test with corrected p-value
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Running maxstat test for OS\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

maxstat_obj <- maxstat.test(
  Surv(OS_months, Event) ~ median_TFx,
  data = os_df,
  smethod = "LogRank",
  pmethod = "HL",
  minprop = MINPROP,
  maxprop = 1 - MINPROP
)

cat("\nMaxstat result:\n")
print(maxstat_obj)

writeLines(
  capture.output(print(maxstat_obj)),
  file.path(out_dir, "04_OS_maxstat_test_output.txt")
)

maxstat_cutpoint <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(maxstat_obj$estimate))
maxstat_p <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(maxstat_obj$p.value))

maxstat_summary <- tibble(
  method = "maxstat.test",
  outcome = "Overall survival",
  marker = "median_TFx",
  smethod = "LogRank",
  pmethod = "HL",
  minprop = MINPROP,
  maxprop = 1 - MINPROP,
  maxstat_cutpoint = maxstat_cutpoint,
  maxstat_corrected_p_value = maxstat_p
)

write_csv(
  maxstat_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "04_OS_maxstat_test_summary.csv")
)

print(maxstat_summary)


############################################################
# 9. Bootstrap cutpoint stability
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Bootstrap cutpoint stability for OS\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

patient_ids <- unique(os_df$patient_id)

get_boot_cutpoint <- function(iteration_id) {
  
  sampled_ids <- sample(
    patient_ids,
    size = length(patient_ids),
    replace = TRUE
  )
  
  boot_df <- bind_rows(
    lapply(sampled_ids, function(id) {
      os_df %>% filter(patient_id == id)
    })
  )
  
  # Safety checks
  if (nrow(boot_df) < 30) return(NA_real_)
  if (sum(boot_df$Event == 1, na.rm = TRUE) < 10) return(NA_real_)
  if (length(unique(boot_df$median_TFx)) < 5) return(NA_real_)
  
  out <- tryCatch({
    
    boot_cut_obj <- surv_cutpoint(
      data = boot_df,
      time = "OS_months",
      event = "Event",
      variables = "median_TFx",
      minprop = MINPROP
    )
    
    boot_summary <- as.data.frame(summary(boot_cut_obj))
    
    # If summary is empty or malformed, return NA
    if (nrow(boot_summary) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    if (!"cutpoint" %in% colnames(boot_summary)) return(NA_real_)
    
    # Extract cutpoint safely
    if ("variable" %in% colnames(boot_summary)) {
      cp <- boot_summary$cutpoint[boot_summary$variable == "median_TFx"]
    } else {
      cp <- boot_summary$cutpoint[1]
    }
    
    # If no cutpoint found, return NA
    if (length(cp) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    if (is.na(cp[1])) return(NA_real_)
    
    return(as.numeric(cp[1]))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NA_real_)
  })
  
  # Final safety: always return length 1
  if (length(out) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  return(as.numeric(out[1]))
}

boot_cuts <- purrr::map_dbl(seq_len(N_BOOT), get_boot_cutpoint)

boot_df <- tibble(
  iteration = seq_len(N_BOOT),
  boot_cutpoint = boot_cuts
)

write_csv(
  boot_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "05_OS_bootstrap_cutpoints_all_iterations.csv")
)

boot_clean <- boot_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(boot_cutpoint))

cat("\nBootstrap successful iterations:", nrow(boot_clean), "of", N_BOOT, "\n")

if (nrow(boot_clean) == 0) {
  stop("All bootstrap iterations failed. Check Event coding, OS_months, median_TFx distribution, and MINPROP.")
}

boot_summary <- tibble(
  n_boot_requested = N_BOOT,
  n_boot_successful = nrow(boot_clean),
  n_boot_failed = N_BOOT - nrow(boot_clean),
  bootstrap_mean = mean(boot_clean$boot_cutpoint, na.rm = TRUE),
  bootstrap_median = median(boot_clean$boot_cutpoint, na.rm = TRUE),
  bootstrap_sd = sd(boot_clean$boot_cutpoint, na.rm = TRUE),
  bootstrap_min = min(boot_clean$boot_cutpoint, na.rm = TRUE),
  bootstrap_q025 = as.numeric(quantile(boot_clean$boot_cutpoint, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
  bootstrap_q25 = as.numeric(quantile(boot_clean$boot_cutpoint, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
  bootstrap_q75 = as.numeric(quantile(boot_clean$boot_cutpoint, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
  bootstrap_q975 = as.numeric(quantile(boot_clean$boot_cutpoint, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
  bootstrap_max = max(boot_clean$boot_cutpoint, na.rm = TRUE)
)

write_csv(
  boot_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "05_OS_bootstrap_cutpoint_summary.csv")
)

print(boot_summary)

boot_plot <- ggplot(boot_clean, aes(x = boot_cutpoint)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "black", fill = "grey80") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = exploratory_cutpoint, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = PUBLISHED_TFX_CUTPOINT, linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = CURRENT_MEDIAN_CUTPOINT, linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap stability of exploratory OS TFx cutpoint",
    subtitle = "Dashed = exploratory cutpoint; dotted = 7%; dotdash = 8.17%",
    x = "Bootstrap-derived median TFx cutpoint (%)",
    y = "Frequency"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "05_OS_bootstrap_cutpoint_histogram.pdf"),
  plot = boot_plot,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 5.5
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "05_OS_bootstrap_cutpoint_histogram.png"),
  plot = boot_plot,

  height = 5.5,

)

  input_file = input_file,

  surv_cutpoint_median_TFx = exploratory_cutpoint,
  maxstat_median_TFx = maxstat_cutpoint,
  maxstat_corrected_p_value = maxstat_p,
  bootstrap_median_cutpoint = boot_summary$bootstrap_median,
  bootstrap_95CI_lower = boot_summary$bootstrap_q025,
  bootstrap_95CI_upper = boot_summary$bootstrap_q975,
  published_reference_cutpoint = PUBLISHED_TFX_CUTPOINT,
  current_median_cutpoint = CURRENT_MEDIAN_CUTPOINT,
  interpretation = "Exploratory/hypothesis-generating; not externally validated"
)

write_csv(
  final_reporting,
  file.path(out_dir, "11_OS_final_reporting_table.csv")
)

print(final_reporting)


############################################################
# 14. Save session info
############################################################

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  con = file.path(out_dir, "12_OS_sessionInfo.txt")
)


############################################################
# Done
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("OS exploratory cutpoint analysis complete.\n")
cat("Outputs saved to:\n")
cat(out_dir, "\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
```
